svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-blues-class-a-coat-female-senior-officer","name":"Women's Class A coat senior member officer layer: epaulets with gray epaulet sleeves, US lapel insignia, 1/2 in blue sleeve braid (overlay, blank grade)","size_in":{"w":24.3883,"h":29.4756},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2438.83,2947.56],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Sleeve braid width 0.5 in and 3 in from the sleeve end per CAPR 39-1 4.1.5.2 / 4.1.9.2; epaulet width and length estimated from DAFI 36-2903 Figs 4.6-4.7 and the cadet board strips; US insignia size estimated. Braid tone: sampled from CAPR 39-1 (3 Mar 2020) rendered at 3x, Fig 4.6 PDF p64 (p.36) braid 2.3,33.1,86.2 / 2.7,31.9,84.3; Fig 4.1 PDF p54 (p.26) 2.1,32.3,83.6; Fig 4.7a PDF p73 (p.45) 2.1,32.4,84.6 against coat 0,40,101 (the figures draw a tonal braid, ~0.72x the coat luminance); drawn in the figure's line structure, 0.04 in lines on a 0.1 in pitch, but lighter than the figure: the tonal band repeats C/Col Doran's \"too close to the jacket colour\" (mess dress braid #0b1f5e, 1.1x the coat luminance, 2026-10-12) and the flat #2149a0 (5.3x) was \"too light\" (2026-10-14), so lines #1e3c82 (3.6x), gaps #12286a (1.9x), edge #0a1740 on the coat #001c52, band mean 2.5x, the geometric mean of the two rated
